about: A Node.js library that packs a whole folder into a zip or tar file.

prs.title: Long file paths survive in tar archives
prs.broken: Tar files cut every path at 100 characters. Two files with long, similar paths got the same name, so unpacking kept only one of them.
prs.changed: I made it record the full path in a standard extra header that tar tools read.
prs.matters: Folders with deep paths, like node_modules, unpack with every file.
